title: Richard Dedekind: Source-Witnessed Working Drafts and English Translations
version: 2026-06-04 Dedekind GMW Volume I Items I-IV
description:
Dedicated Richard Dedekind author record for source-witnessed working drafts and English translations. Current reader surface includes the collected Gesammelte mathematische Werke PDFs, the German/English working draft of Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen?, the early Stetigkeit und irrationale Zahlen segment, Dedekind/Dirichlet paratext items LII-LIX, and a source-witnessed German/English cumulative layer for GMW Volume I Items I-IV.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. Source witnesses and package ledgers should be used to verify formulas, references, and typography before citation-critical use.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Current public surface promotes GMW Volume I Items I-IV as working/source-witnessed material, not as a certified critical edition. The latest source packet includes the printed pp.27-39 source scan slice; next continuation follows the GMW Volume I Item IV layer.
